biggest_catch: Very long Election Day (6:00 a.m. until closing is finalized — roughly 13+ hours) for a flat $200.
catches: Election-day only work, not steady employment.
Very long day: 6:00 a.m. until the closing process is finalized (typically 13-15 hours).
Mandatory poll worker training required, no exceptions.
Must be 18+, an Alabama registered voter residing in Jefferson County, no felony conviction, and not a candidate's family member.
Student intern positions are unpaid — only adult poll workers are paid.

steps: Be 18+, an Alabama registered voter residing in Jefferson County, with no felony conviction.
Complete the Poll Worker Application on the official Jefferson County Probate Court page.
Attend the mandatory poll worker training (no exceptions).
Work Election Day from 6:00 a.m. until the closing process is finalized.
timing: Election Day 6:00 a.m. until closing process finalized (official county requirement), plus mandatory training beforehand.
